## [1.10.0](https://github.com/benzophury/oraimo-health-morphe-patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0) (2026-10-04)

### ✨ New Features

* **target:** update offline network patch and add support for v2.0.6 ([4d857ec](https://github.com/benzophury/oraimo-health-morphe-patches/commit/4d857ec650b4bc3f49008a138d0d6828bab1beae))

patches.name: DNS Hardcoding
patches.description: Hardcodes DNS lookup in OkHttp to fail locally with UnknownHostException, preventing any remote DNS or HTTP traffic.

patches.name: Hide Navigation Tabs (Layout)
patches.description: Statically collapses Mall, Sport, and Mine tabs to 0dp in activity_main.xml, keeping Data and Device tabs.

patches.name: Manifest Debloat
patches.description: Prunes background telemetry upload services, aggressive keepalive daemons, and cloud activities from AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Offline Network Mode
patches.description: Forces network utilities to report disconnected and disables network change listeners.
